_comment: Drives test/klippy/delta_calibrate.test under the simavr bridge in tick-mode lockstep, mirroring delta.fixture.json. Same throughput-bound exclusion delta hit in free-run sim_time; tick_mode pins simavr's advance to klippy's reactor cycle so the per-step UART traffic always lands inside the simulated moment it was sent. delta_calibrate.cfg has no thermistors / heaters / sensors past the three towers' endstops, so only auto_trsync_trigger_ticks is needed; analog_in_default is harmless-but-unused. The cfg's rotation_distance was also rescaled from 0.32 to a real-printer 40 mm/rev so the AVR atmega2560 can sustain the step pulse train (the original 0.32 was a fileoutput-only contrivance for clean integer heightN_pos values; see the cfg header comment) - that rescale is what actually unblocks the test under the real-MCU bridge.
